candidates.title: Sale badge does not appear if there is a variant with a 0 compare_at_price
candidates.reason: No merged fix PR or commit pair exists in Shopify/dawn; HEAD snippets/card-product.liquid lines 139 and 563 retain 'card_product.compare_at_price > card_product.price and card_product.available'.
candidates.notes: Investigated from Section 6 lead #1. Because product.compare_at_price equals compare_at_price_min across non-nil variants (including explicit 0), a zero compare_at_price on one variant masks higher compare_at_price values on sibling variants, but Shopify closed the issue as not_planned without an upstream patch.

candidates.title: Compare-at price doesn't show if varied across multiple variants
candidates.reason: Closed as intentional Dawn design without a fix commit in Shopify/dawn; HEAD snippets/price.liquid preserves 'unless product.price_varies == false and product.compare_at_price_varies'.
candidates.notes: Investigated from Section 6 lead #2. While #871 itself has no merged fix, the upstream origin of that exact Liquid guard was traced to merged PR #662 (057e8fcea41b13eb5458bcdcc94a4c6d44e78b8d -> 37c1c64857c60c5e2e40b345981adb2dc937e776), which moved the check from CSS (.price--no-compare) into Liquid.
